source.snippet: I have a Google Form that is used to receive bookings for a variety of events. People forget that they have already booked for an event and end up booking a second time. I cannot limit respondents to one response per email, because people can book for more than one event. I thought of creating a Google Apps Script that works on the Google Sheet...

problem_statement: Event organizers and small business operators using Google Forms for bookings have no built-in way to detect and alert on duplicate registrations per event, causing overbooking confusion and manual cleanup work.
target_segment: Event organizers, community managers, and small business owners using Google Forms and Sheets for booking management
notes: Moderate buyer signal: operators managing real bookings (implying revenue or attendance accountability). Pain is concrete and recurring ('frequently'). Opportunity: a lightweight Google Workspace add-on or Zapier-style automation that flags duplicate event-email combos. This is a recurring gap in the Google Forms ecosystem — multiple similar questions exist across Stack communities.
